eveningHours.title: Engine + scripts (free)
steps: Open Ashline.uproject UE 5.8.2, compile AshlineEditor Win64 Development
Add Feature or Content Pack → Starter Content
Tools → Execute Python Script → Scripts/import_fab_kits.py
Tools → Execute Python Script → Scripts/create_master_materials.py
Tools → Execute Python Script → Scripts/assign_interim_meshes.py
PIE: mannequin or blockout, not a capsule. HUD Ashline_PC_Ultra / D3D12

eveningHours.title: Characters — MetaHuman + GASP (free)
steps: Enable MetaHuman plugin, Creator → Bridge → /Game/Ashline/Characters/MetaHuman/
Assign body to DA_Hero_Operator.BodyMesh or SK_AshlineHero
Assign face to SkinMaterial / SK_AshlineHero_Face
Fab: Game Animation Sample 5.8 — migrate SKM_UEFN_Mannequin + Motion Matching AnimBP to DA_Hero_Operator.AnimClass
Optional: MetaHuman Crowds cheaper LODs → DA_AI_*
Optional paid: US Marine GRENADIER Modular → Hero/Parts/{Helmet,Vest,Pants,Gloves,Boots}

eveningHours.title: Weapons + material libraries
steps: Lyra Starter Game: migrate 7 weapon meshes onto SM_WPN_* names
Optional paid: Modern Firearms & Explosives Pack — same 7 IDs on DA_WPN_*
Duplicate M_Weapon_Master → M_SKIN_FACTORY / FDE / OD / SNOW / GOLD + weapon uniques
Fab search Military Camo / Weapon Material Library → Materials/Libraries/

eveningHours.title: Megascans — hero missions first
steps: ASH-01 Wire Cut: Forest Floor, Dirt Ground, Concrete Wall, Chainlink, Flood Light
ASH-02 Dust Market: Desert Sand, Adobe, Market Stall, Fabric Canopy
ASH-07 Whiteout: Snow Ground, Pine Tree, Ice
ASH-12 Ashline: Brutalist Concrete, Emissive Panel, Bunker Door
ASH-04 / ASH-10: glass + urban concrete (M_Glass_Master instances)
Remaining ASH-03,05,06,08,09,11 surfaces + props
Leave bOverrideMood unchecked unless you authored a custom mood

eveningHours.title: Audio / FX / FSR / PIE all 12
steps: Lyra fire/hit/reload → SC_Fire_{WeaponId}
Niagara muzzle → NS_Muzzle_{WeaponId} or Starter P_Explosion fallback
AMD FSR for UE 5.8 (GPUOpen). Without plugin Ultra uses TSR
PIE ASH-01…12. After Megascans: stat fps / stat streaming / r.Streaming.PoolSize
If VRAM spikes: foliage.DensityScale=0.7 and keep pool ≤ 8 GB on 16 GB GRE
